commands.name: chunky-start
commands.label: Start generation
commands.description: Starts a new chunk generation task, using the existing selection or one defined in the command itself.

commands.name: chunky-pause
commands.label: Pause generation
commands.description: Pauses current tasks and saves progress so they can be resumed with continue.

commands.name: chunky-continue
commands.label: Continue generation
commands.description: Continues current or saved tasks.

commands.name: chunky-cancel
commands.label: Cancel generation
commands.description: Stops and deletes current or saved tasks, which cannot be resumed afterwards.

commands.name: chunky-world
commands.label: Select world
commands.description: Sets the target world.

commands.name: chunky-shape
commands.label: Select shape
commands.description: Sets the shape to generate.

commands.name: chunky-center
commands.label: Set center
commands.description: Sets the center block location.

commands.name: chunky-radius
commands.label: Set radius
commands.description: Sets the radius (or radii) in blocks; the second radius is only used for rectangle or ellipse shapes.

commands.name: chunky-worldborder
commands.label: Use world border
commands.description: Sets the center and radius to match the world border of the selected or given world.

commands.name: chunky-spawn
commands.label: Center on spawn
commands.description: Sets the center to the default vanilla spawn point in the currently selected world.

commands.name: chunky-corners
commands.label: Select by corners
commands.description: Sets the center and radius automatically based on the two XZ corner coordinates provided.

commands.name: chunky-pattern
commands.label: Set pattern
commands.description: Sets the generation pattern, which determines the order that chunks are generated.

commands.name: chunky-selection
commands.label: Show selection
commands.description: Displays the current selection.

commands.name: chunky-silent
commands.label: Toggle silent
commands.description: Toggles displaying update messages from pre-generation tasks.

commands.name: chunky-quiet
commands.label: Set quiet interval
commands.description: Sets the quiet interval in seconds for update messages from pre-generation tasks.

commands.name: chunky-progress
commands.label: Show progress
commands.description: Displays pre-generation progress for all tasks.

commands.name: chunky-reload
commands.label: Reload
commands.description: Reloads the configuration or tasks.

commands.name: chunky-trim
commands.label: Trim chunks
commands.description: Deletes chunks outside (or inside) the selection; deleted chunks cannot be restored without a backup.

commands.name: chunky-confirm
commands.label: Confirm action
commands.description: Confirms the pending action, such as a trim or cancel, that is waiting for confirmation.

commands.name: chunky-help
commands.label: Help
commands.description: Shows the Chunky command help.
